title: Complete schema-v2 static-site release compatibility
objective: Allow the existing schema-v2 data branch to pass static-site build and smoke checks through the strict compatibility validator, and remove misleading schema-v3-only CLI wording.
forbidden_changes: Do not change schemas, validation semantics, scoring, collectors, frontend, workflows, credentials, or data files.
acceptance_criteria: Schema-v2 site builds and passes check_site.
Site checks reuse the strict privacy/schema validator.
CLI output does not mislabel v2 as v3.
